lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately five horizontal rows of high-luminance circular clusters are visible posterior to the branchial region. The spots are most densely concentrated in the upper visible flank, transitioning to a more sparse arrangement ventrally.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of blobs, creating a grid-like pattern of anchor nodes, most prominently visible in the mid-lateral region posterior to the fifth branchial slit.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two distinct horizontal carinae are visible; the primary ridge displays a sharp vertical gradient with high luminance on its dorsal-facing edge and a dark shadow on its ventral-facing edge, extending from the branchial area toward the caudal region.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A low-density distribution of small, high-luminance blobs is visible on the surface of the dorsal fin, primarily located along the anterior margin and central mid-section.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent, circular dark notch is visible on the posterior trailing edge of the pectoral fin, approximately one-third of the distance from the distal tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Five vertical branchial slits are clearly defined on the anterior lateral flank, exhibiting sharp dark-to-light edge transitions.
